curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when the creators of everyday digital tools step forward to warn the public about the hidden dangers built into their systems?
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Jeff Orlowski, this documentary-drama hybrid investigates the dangerous human impact of social networking, bringing tech industry insiders forward to sound the alarm on the very platforms they built.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, engaged, and soberly paced, offering an alert, eye-opening look at digital culture best suited for focused solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Blending non-fiction testimony with dramatized scenarios, it delivers a focused, urgent breakdown of modern tech design from the perspective of the engineers who helped shape it.
